_comment: One S2S stack: what the Pipecat agent runs for this board row. Copied from
the Coval-native agent it replaces, so the harness changes nothing but who
hosts the pipeline. The prompt comes from the scenario: its own
system-prompt.<stack>.txt when one exists, else system-prompt.txt. The hash
over this file and that prompt goes on every span the agent emits.

turn_detection._why: The provider's own endpointing decides when the caller stopped, as the Coval-native agent ran it. No local VAD, so turn-taking is the model's, not the harness's.

audio._why: The rate this provider takes in and emits. Coval sends 16 kHz and the serializer resamples once on the way in; output is passed through at this rate.
